description: What is in a .glb or .gltf without loading it in a browser: nodes, meshes, triangles, materials, textures with sizes, animations, skins, size in metres, glTF extensions, a draw-call estimate, and which loaders and decoders three.js needs for it (DRACOLoader, MeshoptDecoder, KTX2Loader) with the code to set them up. It also checks the project's code sets those decoders up. Read-only.

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

name: three_model_inspect
title: What is in a model, and how three.js loads it
